description: Electric Vehicle Charging Session Data of Large Office Parking Lot is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Kevin de Bont, Gerwin Hoogsteen. The dataset corresponds to the a.s.r. living lab of the SmoothEMS met GridShield project. The living lab is an office parking lot located in Utrecht, the Netherlands, that hosts EV charging infrastructure for employees and visitors. All datapoints describe electric vehicle charging sessions recorded on-site. Coverage: national (NL); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: CSV. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
